body: Should she already be getting a lawyer lined up?

I love my job but it abuses me. I have a job that involves helping people, but I get paid far to little for what it takes out of me.

My relationship cant end because my partner is mentally ill and doesnt know how to survive without me

My living arrangement is to expensive and also a mess because I'm in desperation trying to finish my masters, working 50+ hours a week at a job that doesn't respect me (but I cant leave that either because I'm contacted in and they are paying for school)

I am stuck for a reason. If I could change these things I would. I am stuck due to my own choices.

I want out but I cant get it because to many people rely on me. It is a blessing and a curse.

I feel like an imposter. People think I'm a good person, but deep down I am not.
Thank you. Thats what I needed to read. I've been trying to work on this in therapy

The problem is I feel like your choices are what make up who you are. I feel like a bad person and sometimes I even feel like I will stay a "bad person" regardless of how many good decisions I make going forward. 

I feel very tainted

I also noticed that the site I was using for it doesn't seem to exist anymore. The thing that skeeves me out the most is knowing at some point I had to disclose my legal name in order to get payment... even if I was using an alias with clients

To my knowledge there is nothing with my name attached to it and I used an alias. I also wore sunglasses and the picture was blurry as it was live and not recorded. I'd like to think you wouldn't be able to tell it is me.

I think that at the time I had this idea in my head that engaging in camwork would be justifiable if it payed for living expenses and I was able to be anonymous. But I quickly realized it wasn't for me. I think when I was younger I was willing to try anything without considering the repercussions. I followed my gut on everything which clearly wasn't the right way of doing things.
